decisions.rationale: Fen stilt hut, 6.5 x 8 m, a tarred-plank hut on a 1.7 m deck with a porch rail and a step ladder, reed thatch to 8.0 m; 516 triangles, 44,972 bytes before meshopt. Walls stay inside the oriented-box collider below 3 m and eaves overhang at most 0.78 m above it (check-kit: OK); baked AO at 48 samples.
limitations: Stilts stand on flat ground; there is no standing water under them yet (lakes come with W3).
The ladder is decorative; the deck is not walkable.
Surfaces are tiled 2 m layers shared by the whole kit; there is no unique wear, grime gradient or decals per building.

decisions.rationale: In Mirecross, Reed Chapel and Lantern Ferry (Fens) at gameplay cameras (18-40 m, pitch 0.38-1.13): reads at true scale beside the 2.25 m soldier, the 2.7 m captain and the 3.9 m boss; shadows ground it on the relief; the 1.6-3.2 m architecture cutaway keeps the hero visible behind it, and a camera inside its bounds (plus 2 m) hides it instead of showing the hollow inside.
limitations: Not enterable: interiors are not modelled.
Lighting is the overcast day grade only; windows never light up.
